say:0:1121118001:0.text: Chippy must be dreaming! Magister! Dura's statue is missing!
say:0:1121118001:0.source_cn: 天、天啊，主人，是满满眼花了吗？！女神像不见了！
say:0:1121118001:0.male: Chippy must be dreaming! Magister! Dura's statue is missing!
say:0:1121118001:0.female: Chippy must be dreaming! Magister! Dura's statue is missing!

say:1:1121118002:0.text: You see what I mean? Everyone's shocked!
